payload.model_patch:
diff --git a/django/db/models/options.py b/django/db/models/options.py
index f027a74976..f53b131162 100644
--- a/django/db/models/options.py
+++ b/django/db/models/options.py
@@ -253,6 +253,30 @@ class Options:
                 auto = AutoField(verbose_name='ID', primary_key=True, auto_created=True)
                 model.add_to_class('id', auto)
 
+    def _get_ordering(self):
+        """
+        Return the ordering for this model. If the ordering contains a
+        reference to 'pk', it is resolved to the actual primary key field
+        name to ensure correct ordering for inherited models.
+        """
+        ordering = self.ordering
+        if not ordering:
+            return ordering
+        resolved = []
+        for item in ordering:
+            if isinstance(item, str):
+                if item in ('pk', '-pk'):
+                    resolved.append(item.replace('pk', self.pk.name))
+                elif item.endswith('__pk') or item.endswith('__-pk'):
+                    # Handle related field lookups ending with pk.
+                    parts = item.rsplit('__', 1)
+                    resolved.append('__'.join([parts[0], parts[1].replace('pk', self.pk.name)]))
+                else:
+                    resolved.append(item)
+            else:
+                resolved.append(item)
+        return resolved
+
     def add_manager(self, manager):
         self.local_managers.append(manager)
         self._expire_cache()
diff --git a/django/db/models/sql/compiler.py b/django/db/models/sql/compiler.py
index 92213a4e67..8022efcf4b 100644
--- a/django/db/models/sql/compiler.py
+++ b/django/db/models/sql/compiler.py
@@ -278,7 +278,7 @@ class SQLCompiler:
         elif self.query.order_by:
             ordering = self.query.order_by
         elif self.query.get_meta().ordering:
-            ordering = self.query.get_meta().ordering
+            ordering = self.query.get_meta()._get_ordering()
             self._meta_ordering = ordering
         else:
             ordering = []
